questions.stem: What does isoprenaline's β1 action increase?
questions.answer: Heart rate, contractility, automaticity and cardiac output

questions.stem: Why can isoprenaline fail to raise blood pressure despite higher cardiac output?
questions.answer: β2 vasodilation lowers SVR enough to offset the rise in cardiac output

questions.stem: What is the main IV indication for isoprenaline?
questions.answer: Severe bradycardia from AV block or beta blockers

questions.stem: Is isoprenaline still used for asthma or reversible airway obstruction?
questions.answer: No, it is no longer used

questions.stem: Why was isoprenaline replaced as an asthma bronchodilator?
options: Its β2 effect was too weak
β1 cardiac effects were blamed for increased asthma deaths

questions.stem: Why is oral isoprenaline bioavailability low?
options: Extensive first-pass metabolism by hepatic COMT

questions.stem: How is isoprenaline mainly excreted in urine?
questions.answer: A large fraction unchanged, plus conjugated metabolites
